cost_v1_h20261004_pm_earnings.borrow_note: Shorts add 1 percent per year pro rata for the holding period (the window is one to two sessions); shorts are restricted to easy-to-borrow large caps in the executable version, the research series computes the spread for all primary events and reports the large-cap-only variant as a sensitivity.
cost_v1_h20261004_pm_earnings.fill_rule: Signal known by 15:00 ET on S, entry at the S closing auction (MOC), exit at the R closing auction. Secondary: exit at the opening auction after R. No limit orders, no price improvement assumed.
cost_v1_h20261004_pm_earnings.note: Costs as frozen in hypotheses.md (10 bp per side primary, 20 bp per side stress, which also covers announcement-day spread widening) and the repository-wide 10 bp convention.
